title: Employ staff under the Air Pilots Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Air Pilots Award 2020.

sources.title: Air Pilots Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This occupational award covers employers throughout Australia of air pilots and helicopter aircrew and those employees. [4.2 varied by PR738768 ppc 07Mar22]

reach.condition: if it employs air pilots or helicopter aircrew and no industry award with pilot classifications covers them (cl 4.1, 4.2)
reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: Occupational award: pilots and helicopter aircrew wherever employed, unless an industry award with pilot classifications applies (cl 4.1, 4.2).

assessment.summary: The Air Pilots Award sets classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates for pilots and helicopter aircrew wherever they are employed.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
